notes: Continue Watching prefers language-tagged landscape title covers instead of text-free catalog backdrops, while retaining explicit app-published promotional artwork.
Trending and New in India now load title-bearing landscape cover candidates on demand for the visible shelf. An intact portrait poster is used while loading or when a landscape cover is unavailable.
Cover files retain the original source bytes, with bounded caches and background loading. Updated artwork binds into the current card without rebuilding the shelf.
Current artwork selections take priority over older saved Apple TV resume artwork. Playback links, progress, content languages and YouTube preferences are preserved.
CleanYourTV shared source remains verified through v3.4.0; the existing ServiceRepair adaptation is retained.
